title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:

- Carrying out Land Registry searches.
- Preparing and sending mortgage and contract reports.
- Requesting property searches and management packs.
- Checking online portals for updates and actions required.

title: Family Law Paralegal
description:
Key Requirements - Essential
- Previous family law experience gained within a law firm.
- Experience assisting with private family matters, including divorce and children matters.
- Strong client care and communication skills.
- Ability to work effectively within a small team.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Professional and proactive approach to client service.

The Role

Envision People is representing a well-established Suffolk law firm seeking a Family Paralegal to join its busy team in Beccles.

The role is predominantly focused on private family law, supporting fee earners on a range of matters including divorce and children work. There will also be the opportunity to gain exposure to private client matters, including wills and probate.

This opportunity would suit a candidate looking to develop their career within a supportive and client-focused legal practice.

Desirable Experience

The following would be advantageous:
- Previous court attendance experience.
- Experience preparing bundles and legal documents.
- Exposure to wills and probate matters.
- Law degree, LPC or SQE studies.

Working Environment
- Full-time office-based position.
- Supportive and friendly team environment.
- Exposure to both family and private client work.
- Opportunity for long-term career development.
- Preference for candidates based locally to Suffolk.

title: Legal Secretary
description:
Private Client Legal Assistant / Legal Secretary

Are you an experienced Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant looking to progress your career within a highly regarded Private Client department?

An established and reputable law firm based in Ipswich is seeking a proactive and organised individual to join its friendly Private Client team. This is an excellent opportunity to support experienced fee earners while gaining exposure to a broad range of private client matters.

The Role

You will provide comprehensive administrative and secretarial support to the Private Client team, assisting with matters including:
- Wills and Estate Planning
- Probate and Estate Administration
- Lasting Powers of Attorney
- Trust Administration
- Court of Protection matters
- General client correspondence and file management

Responsibilities
- Audio and copy typing of legal documents and correspondence
- Preparing legal documents and client packs
- Managing diaries, appointments and meetings
- Opening and closing client files
- Liaising with clients, executors and third parties professionally and empathetically
- Handling telephone and email enquiries
- Maintaining accurate case management records
- Assisting fee earners with the progression of matters

About You

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience as a Legal Secretary, Legal Assistant or Administrator within a law firm
- Ideally experience within Private Client, Conveyancing or another legal discipline
- Excellent communication and client care skills
- Strong organisational and time management abilities
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail
- Proficiency using Microsoft Office and case management systems
- The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary depending on experience
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Ongoing training and career development opportunities
- Generous holiday entitlement
- Pension scheme
- Opportunity to join a respected and established legal practice

If you are looking to join a welcoming firm where you can develop your legal career within a successful Private Client department, we would love to hear from you.

Interested?

Please call Michelle Topley on or email your CV to . Alternatively apply online.
